reason: The README describes a plugin for orchestrating subagents by adding routing guidance and exposing per-call provider/model selection for delegated tasks.

summaries.zh: 通过路由提示和可按调用指定提供商与模型的工具，帮助 DeepSeek Harness 将任务委派给子代理。
summaries.en: Helps the DeepSeek Harness delegate tasks to subagents through routing guidance and per-call provider and model selection.

capabilities: Delegates analysis and implementation tasks to subagents
Selects a provider and model for each delegated task
Adds routing guidance to session system prompts
